volunteerExperiences.description:
-Managed the NJIT's Print Shop, efficiently overseeing print orders for over 1500 architecture students,
including configuration, printing, and assembly of assignments on various paper types and customizations.
-Maintained and serviced a range of printers, ensuring they were in optimal condition for handling 4000 print
jobs per month across 20 different sizes.
-Contributed to customer service and issue resolution, communicating technical details to address order
discrepancies and payment processing.

projects.title: Distributed Order Matching Engine
projects.description:
- Developed distributed order matching engine in Go processing 8,000 orders/second with <500μs latency using concurrent data structures and price-time priority matching algorithm.
- Architected scalable system with Kafka event streaming, Redis caching, and PostgreSQL storage, enabling horizontal scaling and automatic failover
